data.explanation: This is a reminder that the invoice for your furniture delivery has not yet been paid. Check whether you already transferred the €249.00 to Beispiel Wohnwelt GmbH; if you did, the letter says you can ignore this reminder. If you have not paid, transfer the amount to the IBAN shown as soon as possible, ideally before the stated date, to avoid further reminders. Keep any proof of payment in case there is a dispute later. This is only a courtesy reminder, not a formal legal dunning notice, so no extra fees or legal steps are announced here.
